Национальный парк Мачахела.name: Machakhela National Park
Национальный парк Мачахела.description: The Machakhela River gorge near the Turkish border: Colchic forests, old arched bridges, a visitor center and a museum. This is where the route through mountain Adjara begins.

Пляж Кобулети.name: Kobuleti Beach
Пляж Кобулети.description: The long pebble beach of the Kobuleti resort, 30 km north of Batumi, with a pine-lined promenade along the sea. A great first trip in any car.

Смотровая площадка над Батуми.name: Batumi viewpoint
Смотровая площадка над Батуми.description: A hilltop viewpoint by the Gonio Cross with a panorama of Batumi, the sea and the mouth of the Chorokhi River. Best at sunset.

Крепость Анария.name: Anaria Fortress
Крепость Анария.description: Hilltop fortress ruins east of the city overlooking Batumi and the valley. A short trip that's easy to combine with other stops.

Перевал Годердзи.name: Goderdzi Pass
Перевал Годердзи.description: A high mountain pass on the Batumi–Akhaltsikhe road and the Goderdzi ski resort: alpine meadows and views of the Adjara ranges. You'll need an all-wheel-drive car.

Крепость Петра.name: Petra Fortress
Крепость Петра.description: Ruins of a 6th-century Byzantine fortress on a cape above the sea between Batumi and Kobuleti, with a beach and the coastal railway nearby.

Водопад Махунцети.name: Makhuntseti Waterfall
Водопад Махунцети.description: One of the best-known waterfalls in Adjara, 30 km from Batumi. Queen Tamar's medieval arched bridge is a few minutes away.

Каньон Мартвили.name: Martvili Canyon
Каньон Мартвили.description: A turquoise river in a narrow canyon with waterfalls. Walking trails and boat rides make it one of the most popular trips in western Georgia.

Батумский ботанический сад.name: Batumi Botanical Garden
Батумский ботанический сад.description: One of the largest botanical gardens of the former USSR, founded in 1912 on the Green Cape: plants from all over the world and sea views.

Пещера Прометея.name: Prometheus Cave
Пещера Прометея.description: A karst cave near Kutaisi with illuminated halls full of stalactites and stalagmites, plus an underground river boat ride in season.

Крепость царицы Тамары.name: Queen Tamar Fortress
Крепость царицы Тамары.description: Ruins of a medieval hilltop fortress in northern Batumi with views of the city and the sea.

Пляж Сарпи.name: Sarpi Beach
Пляж Сарпи.description: A beach right at the Turkish border with clear water and rocks — great for swimming and snorkeling.

Каньон Окаце: смотровая площадка.name: Okatse Canyon viewpoint
Каньон Окаце: смотровая площадка.description: A metal walkway suspended along a sheer cliff and a platform hanging over the canyon. Breathtaking.

Анаклия.name: Anaklia
Анаклия.description: A resort village with a long sandy beach and a footbridge across the Enguri River — one of the longest in Georgia.

Вардзиа.name: Vardzia
Вардзиа.description: A 12th-century cave monastery from Queen Tamar's era, carved into a cliff on several levels. A long but unforgettable trip.

Визит-центр каньона Окаце.name: Okatse Canyon Visitor Center
Визит-центр каньона Окаце.description: The start of the trail to Okatse Canyon, with a ticket office, parking and a café. Kinchkha Waterfall is nearby.

Мост Дандало.name: Dandalo Bridge
Мост Дандало.description: A 12th-century stone arched bridge over the Adjaristsqali River — one of the most picturesque medieval bridges in Adjara.

Площадка для споттинга.name: Plane-spotting point
Площадка для споттинга.description: A spot by Batumi Airport where planes come in to land right overhead. A favorite with photographers and kids.

Водопад Кинчха.name: Kinchkha Waterfall
Водопад Кинчха.description: A large multi-tiered waterfall in the mountains above Okatse, reached by a trail from the viewpoint.

Дендрологический парк Шекветили.name: Shekvetili Dendrological Park
Дендрологический парк Шекветили.description: A large seaside park with a tree collection, walking alleys and ponds. Shekvetili Beach is right next to it.

Эко-деревня Stone River.name: Stone River Eco Village
Эко-деревня Stone River.description: A mountain getaway near Batumi: a Russian banya on the bank of a mountain river and the quiet of nature.

Водопад Мирвети.name: Mirveti Waterfall
Водопад Мирвети.description: A waterfall in a green gorge 20 km from Batumi, next to an old stone arched bridge.

Гомисмта.name: Gomismta
Гомисмта.description: A mountain village at about 2,000 meters, famous for its "sea of clouds" at sunrise. The road is for all-wheel-drive cars only.

Водопад Андрея Первозванного.name: St. Andrew the First-Called Waterfall
Водопад Андрея Первозванного.description: A small seaside waterfall in Kvariati. According to tradition, the Apostle Andrew preached here.

Paragraph Resort & Spa Шекветили.name: Paragraph Resort & Spa Shekvetili
Paragraph Resort & Spa Шекветили.description: A seaside resort from Marriott's Autograph Collection. Tip: at the checkpoint, say you're heading to the restaurant or spa.

Национальный парк Мтирала.name: Mtirala National Park
Национальный парк Мтирала.description: Mtirala, the "weeping mountain", is one of the rainiest places in Georgia: relict Colchic forest, waterfalls and eco-trails not far from Batumi.

Крепость Кавиани.name: Kaviani Fortress
Крепость Кавиани.description: Ruins of a medieval fortress above the Adjaristsqali gorge on the way into mountain Adjara, near Dandalo Bridge.

Крепость Гонио.name: Gonio Fortress
Крепость Гонио.description: The 1st-century Roman fortress of Apsaros, 12 km from Batumi. According to tradition, the Apostle Matthias is buried here.

Подвесной мост.name: Suspension bridge
Подвесной мост.description: A pedestrian suspension bridge over a mountain river on the way to Mirveti Waterfall.
